definitions.prefill_proxy: actual_prompt_tokens / dispatch-to-first-nonempty-output seconds; includes admission, upload, native prefill, first decode and client overhead; NOT native prefill TPS
definitions.decode_proxy: (actual_completion_tokens - 1) / (last_nonempty_output_arrival - first_nonempty_output_arrival); NOT native decode TPS; first chunk batching and stream buffering bias remain
definitions.power: arithmetic mean and peak of ~1Hz same-request GPU board readings, not whole-machine/wall/PSU power; not transient qualification
definitions.timing_native: native prompt_ms/decode_ms not provided; no native throughput claim
definitions.settlement: terminal SSE/usage/DONE plus full HTTP EOF and exact same owner/readiness/capacity under exclusive ingress; no global idle claim
definitions.repeatability: one measurement percap and600Wdriftanchor; no repeats/no statistical significance claim
